conversations.answer: [CODE_BLOCK_0]This script first creates a new directory named 'handlers' under 'src/backend/'. Then it moves 'generateHandler.js' to the 'handlers' directory. After that, it updates the content of 'generateHandler.js' and 'setupRoutes.js' to reflect the new location of 'generateHandler.js'. The import path in 'generateHandler.js' is updated to '../../prompt/promptProcessing.js' because the file is now one level deeper in the directory structure. The import path in 'setupRoutes.js' is updated to './handlers/generateHandler.js' to reflect the new location of 'generateHandler.js'.
